title: Impact of Merit Scholarships on College Enrollment
research_question: Does meeting a GPA threshold for a merit scholarship influence college enrollment rates? By examining students around the GPA cutoff, we can assess the causal effect of the scholarship on their decision to enroll in college.
data_description: The dataset includes 600 students, with columns for running_var (GPA), treated (indicating if the student meets the GPA threshold), and y (college enrollment status). The data focuses on students near the GPA cutoff for a merit scholarship.
